caption: The drawing consists of two sketches of a diaper or undergarment on an off-white or beige background. Both objects are outlined in fine graphite pencil, with the larger one occupying the lower central portion of the image and the smaller one positioned above it, slightly to the right. The garments are depicted with a rounded, triangular shape and feature overlapping flaps at the front, secured by small circular buttons at each side, with elasticized or gathered edges at the waist and leg openings. The larger garment is more detailed, displaying cross-stitching lines on the overlapping front panels and frilled elastic at the leg holes; a simple curved line is drawn on the right-hand side of the garment. The smaller sketch above shows a plainer back view, with lines indicating elastic and ruffled leg openings, but without the overlapping flap detail. The background is plain and uniform, without color variation or additional decoration. There is faint handwriting in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Diaper Covers
